stemBlocks: At which two of the numbered stages does only mitosis occur?

assets.alt: The diagram shows the life cycle of a simple type of plant. The stages are: adult plant stage P (n), spores (n), adult plant stage Q (2n), female gamete (n), male gamete (n). Arrows indicate transitions: 1 from adult plant stage P to female gamete, 2 from female gamete and male gamete to adult plant stage Q, 3 from adult plant stage Q to spores, 4 from spores to adult plant stage P. Key: n = haploid number of chromosomes, 2n = diploid number of chromosomes.
